name: AI Video Analysis (Pukujan)
promise: An evidence-first archive and analysis harness that turns edited gaming VODs into reusable style knowledge, so the user's own gameplay can be narrated and edited the way the references are.
avoid: claiming a joke, sarcasm or emotion was detected without linked evidence
presenting an interpretation as an observation
guessing words the caption transcript marks as [ __ ]
claiming music identity from acoustic similarity alone
fake metrics or invented precision numbers
speaking for the creators whose videos are analyzed
showing keys, tokens or private file paths
